title: Maybe I'm just lame, but I think having holodecks in space ships is pretty cool
author: Enderoth
selftext: Have y'all been able to implement any wild features in your games that you haven't really seen successfully pulled off elsewhere? This is one I have been iterating on for a fair bit.

comments.author: Enderoth
comments.body:
In case you're wondering about the screen and furniture disappearing, that's an option you can select to hide them. Otherwise you can enjoy the immersive scene along with your viewscreen and lounge and exercise equipment (or whatever you happen to have in there).

And yes, it's meant to be a bit retro 540p pinnacle of PS1-early PS2 in terms of graphics.

comments.author: golfstreamer
comments.body: Is this a VR game? Would be really rad if it was.

replies.author: Enderoth
replies.body: Not yet, but I agree. It has all the makings for it, and I seem to be moving in that direction
